segments.he: (קיב) אָמַרלִי וְכִי אֵין אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ מַה שֶּׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ חָפֵץ, הַשֵּׁם  יִתְבָּרַךְ  אוֹהֵב  אָדָם  מְרֻקָּח.
segments.en: (122.) I heard from his holy mouth an awesome conversation about the awesomeness of the greatness of the Creator, may He be blessed — and it is impossible to explain it in writing. But afterwards through this he entered into words of strengthening — that even if one had fallen to whatever place he had fallen — each one according to his fall, G-d save us — even so, one should strengthen oneself and never despair. For His greatness, may He be blessed, is exalted very far above the Torah — where everything can be repaired etc. — for repentance is above...
